proposal.terms: Payment terms are net 30 days from invoice date. The proposal is valid for 30 days from the date of issuance. Any changes to scope will be addressed through a change order. Work will be performed during normal business hours, Monday through Friday.
proposal.summary: This proposal covers the installation of forty Cat6A network drops in an office building in Sacramento, CA, including all materials and labor. The total cost is $8,159.89, comprising $2,338.00 in materials, $5,200.00 in labor, and $621.89 in tax. The estimate includes assumptions for label sheets and excludes costs for patch panel housing and equipment rack due to lack of pricing evidence. The project will be performed by an electrician and an apprentice, with labor hours totaling 60 and 20 respectively.
assumptions: Label sheet, 100 labels: Code requires labels on both ends of every cable (80 labels for 40 drops), so 2 sheets are needed; evidence only lists 1 sheet for 40 drops.
Patch panel housing: No pricing evidence found for patch panel housing; cost not included.
Equipment rack: No pricing evidence found for equipment rack; cost not included.

issues.description: Patch panel housing and equipment rack are required for patch panel ports but have zero cost and are listed as assumptions. This understates the project cost.
issues.evidence_snippet: Patch panel port: $4.75 each. Need 40 ports for 40 drops.

issues.description: Label sheet quantity increased from 1 to 2 based on code claim, but evidence chunk 8ac031f1 states labels required on both ends; however, the material evidence explicitly says 1 sheet for 40 drops, creating a conflict.
issues.evidence_snippet: Labels are required on both ends of every cable.

issues.description: Proposal omits grounding and bonding requirements for communications equipment and metallic raceways per Article 250, which is a code requirement in the evidence.
issues.evidence_snippet: Communications equipment must be grounded in accordance with Article 250. Cable trays and metallic raceways must be bonded to ground.

issues.description: Proposal does not mention cable support every 5 feet horizontally and maximum bundle size of 50 cables, which are code requirements in the evidence.
issues.evidence_snippet: Cables must be supported every 5 feet when run horizontally.

issues.description: No grounding/bonding materials (e.g., bonding jumpers, ground bars) are included in the BOM despite code requirements for grounding communications equipment.
issues.evidence_snippet: Communications equipment must be grounded in accordance with Article 250.

issues.description: Labor hours: 60 electrician + 20 apprentice = 80 hours for 40 drops (2 hours/drop) matches evidence, but the proposal summary says 'labor hours totaling 60 and 20 respectively' which is correct; no issue.
issues.evidence_snippet: Electrician: 1.5 hours per drop at $75.00 per hour.
